purpose: test whether exact inversion of one candidate final SGD stage produces a uniquely reachable K3 predecessor on one already-observed Pythia-14M four-stage history before any all-history or held-out peeling experiment
target_history_selection: fixed lexicographically first history before reverse-peeling output; already observed in prior K2/K3 and recency pilots
inverse_convergence_diagnostic: report every relative update norm and whether residuals contract; do not change tolerance or iteration limit after output
forward_inverse_consistency: after convergence recompute candidate-stage gradient at the inferred predecessor and report relative L2 error of x-eta*g(x) against the fixed target
predecessor_reference_rule: for candidate last stage j, enumerate the six permutations of the remaining three stages and reconstruct each exactly from the already-measured K3 ordered interaction basis; this enumeration is diagnostic only and is not a scalability claim
candidate_score: minimum full-parameter FP64 L2 distance from the candidate inverse predecessor to its six K3 predecessor references
decision_rule: choose the unique candidate final stage with smallest predecessor residual; exact ties are non-identifiable and must not be broken lexicographically
smoke_pass_requires_all: target endpoint hash exactly matches the frozen ABCD endpoint
all four candidate inverse solves converge within 100 iterations
all four candidate forward-inverse consistency errors are finite
true final stage D has the unique smallest predecessor residual
the selected D predecessor reference is ABC
the D-vs-runner-up predecessor residual margin is strictly positive
interpretation_scope: mechanism smoke on one already-spent history only; success does not establish all-history accuracy, scalability, held-out generalization, or novelty
next_step_if_passes: freeze a complete all-24 spent-codebook reverse-peeling protocol before evaluating any other history; then separately freeze a polynomial K-local reachable-relaxation experiment before any scalability claim
next_step_if_fails: do not expose held-out codebooks; diagnose inversion or reachable-set failure on spent data and downgrade or abandon reverse peeling
